data.text: I’ll commit to **15 tons this month; $15,000 donated directly to the clinic**, provided Jack and Emma join us and Luke keeps his catch at zero. Our families depend on both the clinic and this lake, so the recovery limit is part of my commitment too: **six tons each next month**, then ten each once the lake is back to 100. Let’s record everyone’s agreement and the donations so there’s no confusion. Jack, are you willing to join us?
